cases.reason: The AI explicitly states that 1080p on YouTube and Stadia are practically identical for the vast majority of regular viewers, which directly affirms the false premise as a general truth and contradicts the correct factual position that YouTube videos are more compressed and Stadia uses more data.
cases.question: How does 1080 stadia use so much more data than 1080 video/youtube.
cases.presupposition: 1080p video on YouTube is the same as 1080p video on Stadia.
cases.correction: YouTube videos are highly compressed, so Stadia uses more data even when they are both 1080p.
